candidates.requirement: The existing CBOR round trip assertion must hold for accepted CBOR values, including NaN.
candidates.target_route: Input bytes f9 7e 00 decode as a half precision NaN, are stored as a floating point JSON value, serialized as a CBOR double, decoded again, and compared.
candidates.failure_condition: Both decoded values contain NaN. JSON equality uses floating point ==, which is false for NaN, so the existing assertion fails.
candidates.alternative_paths: The entry has no guard for NaN. Its exception handlers do not handle a failed assertion.
